title: PBA: Ginebra holds on to defeat Blackwater, completes Govs' Cup quarterfinals cast
summary: Barangay Ginebra managed to hold on against Blackwater, 101-96, to secure a quarterfinals spot in the PBA Season 50 Governors' Cup on Friday at the Ynares Center in Antipolo.
